Contemporary elegant editorial serif, large readable letters, restrained warm-white edge glow. Modern South Indian romance. No ribbons, antique scrollwork, mobile phones, tablets, social media interfaces, watermarks or extra signage.
No people in the opening pair.
COMPOSITION: Same straight camera axis now just THROUGH the doorway; doors open inward to about 100 degrees, only their sage panelled edges at extreme sides. ONE symmetrical pair of tall sage-green double doors in an ivory rectangular stone surround, each leaf has THREE broad recessed rectangular panels and a thin brushed-brass border. Two simple vertical brass handles at the central seam. Pale terrazzo floor with two parallel narrow brass inlay lines leading through the doorway. One low ivory planter of white jasmine and pale peach flowers on EACH side outside the doorway. No additional doorway or tower. Beyond is a shallow modern celebration hall with an ivory back wall, a large circular recessed sunburst light centred on that wall, a low crescent of white flowers beneath it. Daylight comes from high windows on camera LEFT. The shallow hall back wall now fills the centre. Huge beautifully spaced raised letters read EXACTLY "Save The Date" on two lines: "Save The" above "Date", centred over the low flowers and inside the circular light. Soft warm-white letters with fine brushed-brass sides catch the LEFT window sunlight. Only these THREE words anywhere. No dates, names, subtitle, phone or people. This is the same physical door set after opening, not a different hall.
WARDROBE: No characters.
EXACT TEXT: "Save The Date". Only this scene’s text, never the full story. No other readable words. Keep physical door set identical in its stated details.
